newsitem.title: GERMANY: Oil World puts Argentine soybean crop at 13 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Oil World puts Argentine soybean crop at 13 mln T.

text.p: The independent Oil World newsletter cut its forecast for this year's Argentine soybean crop to 13.00 million tonnes from 13.40 million last week and compared with last season's 12.53 million.
It cited drought effects which scattered rains were unable to offset and added some private forecasters saw a crop of 12.50 million tonnes if bad weather continued.
Oil World also detailed latest forecasts for other Argentine oilseeds -- sunseed at 5.15 million tonnes (5.56 million in 95/96), cottonseed 700,000 (760,000) and groundnuts 360,000-400,000 (462,000).
Total oilseeds production in 96/97 was put at 19.34 million tonnes, down 140,000 tonnes from 95/96 and compared with a forecast for 96/97 of 20.04 million a week ago.
Argentina also produces rapeseed, safflowerseed and linseed.
Oil World said Brazil's crop weather was more favourable and yield and area expansions may produce a crop of 27.0-27.5 million tonnes versus a revised 23.9 million in 1996.
Higher Brazilian epxort activity would help offset shortfalls in Argentina.
